issues.description: The UML in the problem statement marks the lecture attributes as private, but the template Lecture.java declares lectureName and numberOfInscribedStudents as public. The solution implementation uses private attributes. This visibility discrepancy may confuse students about the intended access level and whether they should implement getters/setters or leave public fields.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the template consistent with the UML and solution: declare all attributes in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java as private (lectureName, numberOfInscribedStudents, numberOfGuestStudents, numberOfLecturers, numberOfTutors) and provide the constructor/getter/setter stubs. Alternatively, if public fields were intended, update the problem statement UML to show public attributes and adjust the solution accordingly.
